description: Defines a composable toggle button component with expanded/collapsed states, including internal layout and preview functions, for use in Android Jetpack Compose UI.

classes.name: NiaViewToggleDefaults
classes.description: Holds default styling values for the toggle button, such as padding.

methods.name: NiaViewToggleButton
methods.description: Main composable function for a toggle button with expanded/collapsed states, customizable text labels, and trailing icon.

methods.name: NiaViewToggleButtonContent
methods.description: Internal layout composable for arranging the button's text label and optional trailing icon.

methods.name: ViewTogglePreviewExpanded
methods.description: Preview composable showing the toggle button in expanded state.

methods.name: ViewTogglePreviewCompact
methods.description: Preview composable showing the toggle button in compact state.
